title: Grant-recipient clawbacks — tax offices levied 365.3m CZK in budget-discipline levies on Czech subsidy recipients in 2025
money_note: 365.3m CZK of odvody za porušení rozpočtové kázně assessed by Czech tax offices in 2025 (the levy alone, excluding 273.8m CZK of late-payment penále), converted at 24.5 CZK/EUR — the rate used by nku-gacr-tacr and nku-zemedelsky-vyzkum
summary: The Finance Ministry's annual financial-control report says Czech tax offices ran 1,816 tax audits of public subsidies covering about 8bn CZK in 2025 and issued 1,769 payment assessments totalling 639.1m CZK, of which 365.3m CZK were levies for breach of budget discipline by grant recipients. The most frequent recipient failures were procurement run against the public-procurement act, distorted or false unit reporting under simplified-cost grants, missed deadlines and indicators, and missing sustainability reports, and recipients filed 193 requests to have levies and penalties waived.
notes: Report of the MF Central Harmonisation Unit (Sekce Finanční řízení a audit), Zpráva o výsledcích finančních kontrol ve veřejné správě za rok 2025, PDF Last-Modified 2026-05-18; chapter 5 'Daňové kontroly veřejné finanční podpory ze strany finančních úřadů'. Staged by the 2026-09-28 weekly demand-scan pass as RECIPIENT-SIDE evidence for the MATCH candidate 'Czech research recipients lose grant money to reporting they got wrong' (NKÚ 24/17, 25/13, 25/18); it is system-wide, not research-specific. Checked counts: 1,816 tax audits (1,118 national, 698 EU funds; EU-fund audits down 46% from 1,021 because of legal uncertainty over preclusion periods), 2,224 projects, 751 on a referral; audited 8,090m CZK vs levies 639m = 7.90% (5.69% 2023, 6.82% 2024); 417 FS staff on this agenda. Recipient pushback: 98 appeals, 35 lawsuits + 14 cassation complaints, 193 waiver requests. Corroborated by the Financial Administration's own Výroční zpráva 2025 (https://celnisprava.gov.cz/cz/statistiky/Documents/vyrocni_zprava-financni-spravy-cr-2025.pdf, Last-Modified 2026-06-30, ch. 5.3): 860 referrals received, 977 payment assessments on the levy totalling 365.3m CZK, 22 criminal complaints, 193 waiver requests seeking 395.6m CZK of which GFŘ waived almost 118.0m CZK. Separately, provider-side § 14f corrective/return measures rose from 826m CZK to 1.6bn CZK. Scale 3: every class of subsidy recipient is touched (state units, 366 municipalities, 495 companies, 858 other bodies audited). Urgency 3: Act 218/2000 § 44/44a is in force and actively enforced — 977 levy assessments in one year. Recurrence 3: statutory and continuous.
quote: Obdobně jako v předchozích letech byla finančními úřady nejčastěji odhalena pochybení v oblasti zadávání veřejných zakázek, kdy příjemci dotací postupují v rozporu se zákonem č. 134/2016 Sb., o zadávání veřejných zakázek
